# @tansy/theme-academy

A school's site for the LMS plugin: the course catalogue, course pages, and plans that open courses, from the Payments plugin.

```bash
npm install @tansy/theme-academy
```

Add it to `tansy.config.ts`. See [the academy theme documentation](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy/blob/main/docs/themes/academy.md) for what it adds and the options it takes.

A first-party theme for [tansy](https://github.com/mhmdsalahsebai/tansy), a self-hosted, runtime-schema CMS for Next.js. MIT licensed.
